title: MindSpore Open-Source Release
summary: Huawei announced on March 28, 2020 that its all-scenario AI computing framework MindSpore had been officially open-sourced.
significance: A dated public open-source release milestone for MindSpore, preserved as a release event rather than an inferred invention or system-birth date.

verification.note: MindSpore's first-party announcement is dated March 28, 2020 and states that Huawei announced MindSpore was officially open-sourced that day. A later first-party Huawei technical retrospective independently states that the MindSpore framework was officially open-sourced on March 28, 2020. This candidate records the public open-source release milestone only; it does not infer MindSpore's invention date, development geography, universal priority, ancestry, influence, causality, or relationship edges.
